notablePrerequisites: Your life total is exactly 3, 4 or 5.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance and Purgatory's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
When Second Chance dies, Purgatory's first ability triggers, exiling it.
Resolve the Purgatory trigger from step 1, causing you to pay {4} and 2 life to return Second Chance from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Ajani Goldmane's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat each turn.
